\begin{document}
\title{Realness miss probe 3}
\maketitle

Throughout, for real energies $\epsilon$ measured from the Fermi level,
the retarded Green's function obeys the spectral relation

\begin{equation}
\label{eq:spectral}
\mathrm{Im}\, G(\epsilon) = -\pi A(\epsilon)
\end{equation}

We also use the elementary identity

\begin{equation}
\label{eq:abssq}
\mathrm{Abs}(\epsilon)^2 = \epsilon^2
\end{equation}

\end{document}
